features.title: Read-only Billy access
features.description: Read and search Billy records without creating, updating, or deleting anything.

features.title: Create and update bank payments
features.description: Create bank-payment records and update existing bank-payment records. It does not enable deleting bank payments.

features.title: Create and update purchases and attachments
features.description: Create and update supplier bills, bill lines, and linked attachments. Payment creation remains controlled by the separate bank-payments feature. This feature does not enable deleting purchase records.

features.title: Manage bank-line reconciliation
features.description: Create, update, and delete bank-line matches and bank-line subject associations used to reconcile Billy postings with imported bank lines.

features.title: Delete reviewed duplicate bank lines
features.description: Delete exact duplicate bank-line IDs only after the fixed preview/commit workflow has re-read and verified the unchanged plan. It does not enable deleting matches, associations, payments, or bookkeeping records.

features.title: Create and update daybook corrections
features.description: Create and update daybook transactions and their lines for controlled accounting corrections. It does not enable deleting daybook records.

features.title: Manage Billy VAT return settlement
features.description: Update Billy VAT/sales-tax return settlement state and create or update Billy sales-tax payment records. This does not submit a return to SKAT or another tax authority.
